Question ID: ANP_U01_L02_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.LAB.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Lab Safety, Measurement, Variables, and Controls
Stimulus: Safety/procedure scenario

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, identify the question being investigated. Then use the required stimulus (Safety/procedure scenario) to connect the visible evidence to safe investigation design, measurement, variables, and controls. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.LAB.01 and avoids the common mistake: changing several variables and calling the result a fair test.
